citations.assessment: Matches the dayyo, palms of bar Maryon’s household, and appearance before Abaye. The Bavli does not repeat the heading’s title in the episode.
The incident of levying charity on the orphans is exact, but the retrieved Bavli reads Rabbah and the Warsaw entry reads Rava.

holds.reason: Retain the printed Rava and record the direct variant Rabbah. Which reading represents the source used by Heilprin is open.
